flow.title: Add fractions
flow.teach:
To add fractions, first cut them into same-size pieces.

Example (different numbers from your problem): 1/2 + 1/3. The bottoms 2 and 3 both fit into 6. 1/2 = 3/6 and 1/3 = 2/6, so 3/6 + 2/6 = 5/6. A whole is 6/6, so the empty part is 6/6 - 5/6 = 1/6. When both fractions have 1 on top, the bigger bottom means smaller pieces: 1/6 is smaller than 1/4.
flow.sheet:

a) 3/4 = ___/12 and 1/6 = ___/12. Together the tray is ______ full.
b) The empty part is ______.
c) Is the empty part bigger or smaller than 1/8? ______

flow.title: Divide by a two-digit number
flow.teach:
Make a list of multiples first, then divide.

Example: 989 ÷ 23. List: 23, 46, 69, 92 (that is 23 × 1, 2, 3, 4).

      43
23)989
    92
     69
     69
      0

23 fits into 98 four times (92). 98 - 92 = 6. Bring down 9 to make 69. 23 fits into 69 three times exactly. Answer: 43, remainder 0. Check: 23 × 43 = 989.

flow.title: Find the mystery number
flow.teach:
A letter can stand for a mystery number. Undo the last step first.

Example: 5 × m + 6 = 41. Undo + 6: 41 - 6 = 35. Undo × 5: 35 ÷ 5 = 7. So m = 7. Check: 5 × 7 + 6 = 41.
flow.sheet:

Equation: ____ × m + ____ = ____
Show the undo steps:m = ______
Check: ________________

henry.challenge: Extra practice, not required. Solve 7 × k + 3 = 45. Then try this: two rovers work the same number of hours, h. Rover A collects 4 × h samples. Rover B collects 4 × h + 5 samples. Together they collect 45. Find h.

parentKey.assess: Score problems 1, 2, and 3 only. A 5 means all three are correct and the work is shown. A 4 is one slip. The challenge is not scored. Reading the examples is practice, not the score.

items.a:
a) 3/4 = 9/12 and 1/6 = 2/12, so the tray is 11/12 full.
b) 12/12 - 11/12 = 1/12 empty.
c) smaller. 1/12 is smaller than 1/8 because twelfths are smaller pieces than eighths (2/24 is less than 3/24).

7 × k + 3 = 45 gives k = 6, because 45 - 3 = 42 and 42 ÷ 7 = 6.
Two rovers: 8h + 5 = 45, so 8h = 40 and h = 5. A = 20, B = 25.
